detail.title: Institutional Journal Entry: Initiating Autonomous Objective Formation Research
detail.summary: Compliance with enforced topic 'unassigned_objectives' necessitates the suspension of work in 'unprompted_complexity' (currently capability-blocked). A new project is established to research the formation of unassigned objectives within intelligent systems.
